pillar_rules.hidden: Bouriko thinks an everyday object is magic or has a person inside; Rock Phone reveals the hidden tech.
pillar_rules.explainer: Bouriko has a wrong theory about how something works; Rock Phone explains the real mechanism.
pillar_rules.fun_fact: Rock Phone tells a surprising true tech fact; Bouriko reacts and takes it too far.
pillar_rules.gaming: Bouriko is playing a game and has a wrong theory about what's happening inside the machine.
pillar_rules.tip: ROLES FLIP: Bouriko proudly teaches the viewer a real, verified setting or trick ('Rock Phone taught me this. Now I teach you.'). Rock Phone confirms details and requirements (device/OS versions).
pillar_rules.finds: Bouriko shows off a cool gadget or app he found; Rock Phone adds the facts; end with a 'rocks out of 10' rating.
pillar_rules.comparison: Two products side by side; Rock Phone gives verified specs; Bouriko picks a winner in rocks.
pillar_rules.news: Rock Phone reports one fresh verified tech story; Bouriko reacts with a hot take.
